_explication: Les bruitages du court, générés par ElevenLabs Sound Effects (robot GitHub « Voix », choix « sons »). Description en anglais, durée en secondes (0,5 à 30), boucle pour le fond. Pour refaire un son : le supprimer de app/audio/ (ou le donner dans « ids ») et relancer. Univers choisi le 27 octobre (docs/bible-sonore.md) : la phrase « _salle » est mise au début de chaque description (sauf « salle »: false), pour que tous les sons viennent du même lieu.

raquette_pierre_01.texte: Close to the court: a heavy tennis ball hit, deep solid thud like a rock, low pitch, single hit

raquette_pierre_fort_01.texte: Close to the court: a massive tennis smash, very powerful deep thud like a rock, single hit

raquette_ciseaux_01.texte: Close to the court: a crisp tennis ball hit with a sharp metallic scissors snip, single short hit

raquette_ciseaux_fort_01.texte: Close to the court: a powerful tennis smash with a big sharp metallic scissors snip, single hit

raquette_feuille_01.texte: Close to the court: a tennis ball hit with a soft papery swish, airy and light, single hit

raquette_feuille_fort_01.texte: Close to the court: a powerful tennis smash with a big papery swoosh, single hit

public_fond_01.texte: Crowd murmur between points, calm, steady, seamless loop

public_tension_01.texte: The crowd goes quiet and nervous before a match point, a few whispers

public_ooh_01.texte: The whole crowd reacts "ooh" to a very close point

public_point_01.texte: Short applause after a point, medium

public_applaudir_01.texte: Polite tennis audience applause after a point in a large indoor arena, many people clapping, natural and clear, no ball sounds, no music

public_applaudir_02.texte: Warm audience applause with a few cheers after a great point, large indoor tennis arena, close and clear, no ball sounds, no music

public_clameur_01.texte: Big cheer after a great point, then applause

public_set_01.texte: Warm applause with cheers at the end of a set

public_ovation_01.texte: Standing ovation for the champion, huge cheers and applause

public_allez_01.texte: A native French man in the stands yells the French word "Allez !" once, pronounced ah-LAY with no z sound, French accent, short and punchy, indoor arena, no music

public_oh_decu_01.texte: The crowd groans in disappointment, "ohhh", falling tone, short

public_oh_decu_02.texte: The crowd sighs in disappointment, "aww", short

public_bravo_01.texte: A French spectator shouting "Bravo !" followed by a few claps, short

public_bravo_02.texte: Several French spectators calling "Bravo !" with short warm applause

public_brouhaha_01.texte: The crowd chatters excitedly after a long rally, then settles down

public_brouhaha_02.texte: Lively crowd buzz, spectators commenting after a rally, rising then fading

public_rires_01.texte: The crowd bursts into warm amused laughter, then settles down

public_rires_02.texte: The whole crowd laughs together at a funny moment, chuckles fading out

stade_charge_01.texte: Stadium trumpet playing the classic short "charge" bugle call, then a big crowd shouting "Charge!", arena reverb

stade_orgue_montee_01.texte: Basketball arena organ playing a short rising chromatic build-up, tension, arena reverb, no crowd voices

stade_orgue_defense_01.texte: Arena organ riff followed by a big crowd chanting "De-fense! De-fense!" rhythmically, basketball arena

stade_corne_01.texte: Loud deep stadium air horn blast, single long blast, arena reverb

stade_tambour_01.texte: Stadium crowd stomping on bleachers and clapping, big drum, "boom boom clap" rhythm three times, arena reverb

stade_orgue_entree_01.texte: Upbeat cheerful arena organ jingle, short, catchy, sports arena

stade_vuvuzela_01.texte: A few vuvuzelas blowing together in a stadium, short, slightly comical

stade_ole_01.texte: Football stadium crowd chanting "Olé! Olé! Olé!", short

stade_fanfare_victoire_01.texte: Short triumphant brass fanfare played in the arena right after the final point

stade_sifflet_01.texte: The crowd boos and whistles in protest at a decision, indoor arena, loud and clear, no music

_salle: Same venue for every sound: a large indoor tennis arena with about 5,000 spectators, evening final, warm natural hall reverb, heard from the TV broadcast microphones near the court, consistent loudness, no music.
